decision_reason: Activate after target-macro compatibility fix: actual PDP10 __PDP10__ and original __pdp10__ both select expected 0x111 from 24-bit bitfield converted to 9-bit char. Only macro condition changed, original assertion preserved; GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os and KCC noopt/opt pass. Original lowercase-only source failed both baselines.

Activate narrow GCC default-case regression: f(1) must return 0 in out-of-range switch; six 0x402..0x407 case arms are not executed, so no case-body correctness claim. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os pass. KCC noopt Dlink RH18 overflow/link failure kept; duplicate PDP10 source remains deferred for KCC toolchain.

Retain compiler investigate: __builtin_strcmp on X vs X\376 must produce negative result. GCC PDP6 O0 executes original abort and fails. KCC noopt unresolved __builtin_strcmp linker symbol; no fake builtin implementation and no oracle weakening.

Activate GCC GNU nested function and VLA: f(2) creates a[n], stores 4711 at index 1, nested g(1) retrieves value and main aborts if mismatch. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os pass and assembly retains VLA allocation/nested call. KCC GNU nested syntax unsupported.

Activate GCC explicit 12-case 32-bit high/low packing into unsigned long long: build and return 71-bit ULL result with original 12 abort assertions. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os pass. KCC noopt runtime fails; 32-bit halves are bit-pattern source values, not PDP10 hardware native halfwords.

Activate GCC O0 only for by-value 11-byte struct with flag==99, actual strcpy and strcmp roundtrip. GCC O0 passes; O1/O2/Os runtime fail (observed). KCC noopt passes, KCC opt emits unresolved strcmp link error; CPU-wide KCC status error conservatively covers both opt modes with split recorded in ledger.

Activate GCC extraction: shift signed 71-bit long long input 0x0123456789ABCDEF by 8, mask 0xff, assert 0xCD; GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os pass. KCC noopt runtime fails original 8-bit mask assertion; preserve for later compiler sweep.

Retain deferred: nested GNU functions, trampolines and callback call pass GCC O0 but source has no assertion that foo callback executes; O1/O2/Os simulator run fails. GCC generated indirect calls/trampoline, but process exit alone cannot verify callback effects. KCC rejects nested syntax. Preserve for later focused harness strengthening, not a passing semantic regression.

Activate GCC with scoped oracle: with default DUMMY_SIZE=399999 PDP6 9-bit characters, unoptimized GCC actually adjusts stack by about 100000 words, calls g 3 times and asserts f()==3.0; GCC O0/O1/O2/Os pass. Optimizers may eliminate unused dummy so optimized pass only arithmetic/control flow, not full large-stack stress. KCC noopt runtime fails.

Activate GCC long-long switch: wwrite((long long)0) must take default and return 123 or abort. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os pass; 3/10/23/28/47 case arms are not called. KCC noopt INTERNAL COMPILER ERROR sizetype: null type at wwrite; record for later compiler sweep, do not fix compiler here. Identical PDP10 copy stays deferred.
